identity.one_liner: 面向开发者学习构建生成式与 Agent 系统的 AI 资源清单
identity.review: 一份由自动化流程每周评审维护的 AI 学习与实践资源精选清单，收录书籍、课程、论文、指南与开源工具链接，覆盖基础理论、LLM 应用工程、协议规范、Agent 框架、检索、评估、部署观测及编码 Agent 等分类。声明每条目须经质量门槛筛选，非全量产品目录。以 Markdown 清单形式提供，无安装或运行环节，资源多为外部链接。
highlights: 按学习路径组织：书籍/课程/基础论文到构建、评估、部署
收录 Agent 框架、MCP/A2A 协议及编码 Agent 等工程资源条目
声明由证据驱动的自动化流程每周评审与合并更新
use_cases: 系统学习大模型与 Agent 开发的基础知识
查找 LLM 应用工程各环节的开源工具与指南
按论文（Transformer、RAG、LoRA、RLHF 等）溯源技术原理

evidence: L3: An opinionated, actively maintained collection of resources for software developers learning to build and ship generativ
L14: This is not a comprehensive directory of AI products. Every entry must clear an absolute quality bar for technical depth

providers.note: 指南与提示工程技术来源方
quotes: - Building Effective Agents: Anthropic's practical patterns and tradeoffs for agentic systems.
- Anthropic Prompt Engineering: Techniques for defining success criteria, testing prompts, and improving model behaviour
- Awesome DeepSeek Agent: DeepSeek's official setup guides for integrating its models with coding agents including Claud
- vLLM: An inference and serving engine for language models.

products.note: 清单收录条目，非替代/竞品
quotes: - Claude Code: A terminal agent with hooks, subagents, skills, and repository-level instructions.
- Cursor CLI: A terminal agent connected to Cursor's editor and cloud workflows.
- GitHub Copilot coding agent: An asynchronous agent that works from GitHub issues and opens pull requests.
